visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with several close-up shots of a refrigerated display case filled with various containers of marinated seafood. Black plastic bowls hold raw crabs submerged in soy sauce, while white bowls contain peeled shrimp and other shellfish. Brightly colored price tags in green and white are placed atop each container. The lighting is the cool, bright glow of a commercial refrigerator. (2) The scene shifts to a wider shot of a seafood stall in a bustling market. A blue sign with '369' and Korean text hangs above. A male vendor wearing a black apron and plastic gloves is seen using large metal scissors to cut a marinated crab into smaller pieces on a stainless steel counter. He works quickly and efficiently, placing the pieces into a white plastic container. (3) A young woman with long, straight black hair, wearing a grey turtleneck layered under a white sleeveless top and denim shorts, stands in front of the market stall. She smiles broadly, holds up a white plastic shopping bag, and gestures towards the food display. Behind her, the vendor smiles and gives a double thumbs-up to the camera. The background shows other market stalls with bright artificial lighting and various products. (4) The woman is now indoors, sitting at a table in what appears to be a hotel room. She has opened the large white container of crabs and a smaller black bowl of shrimp. She speaks directly to the camera with animated facial expressions, pointing at the food. She picks up a piece of crab with her hands, shows the meaty interior to the lens, and begins eating it with great relish, sucking the meat from the shell and licking her fingers. The room is dimly lit with warm, soft lighting, and personal items like a backpack and water bottle are visible on the table behind her.
